id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

started.description:
When the session was started. This can be different from the {@link ExMachinaInstance#started} time in cases
where the {@link instance} was started preemptively.

instance.description:
A reference to the underlying ExMachina instance used during the session. Each session has a unique instance,
which is enforced using the {@link Ann.Db#unique} annotation.

member.description: The member who started the session

title:
ExMachinaSession refers to the time period that a user attempts to Start and Stop a single ExMachina spark cluster,
and stores a reference to the underlying {@link ExMachinaInstance} used during the session.

In order from lowest to highest abstraction, there are three orchestration types:
1. {@link ExMachina}: The core CloudService
2. {@link ExMachinaInstance}: Simplifies orchestration of ExMachina service and persists service metadata.
3. {@link ExMachinaSession}: User-level details that persists information of single usage of CloudService.
name: ExMachinaSession
